title: Data Presentation: Tables and Charts
seo_title: Data Presentation – SSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Present data in frequency tables, bar charts, histograms and pie charts; read and interpret these charts; group data in classes. (summary of the NERDC SSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 1 maths worksheets on statistics: frequency tables, grouped data, class marks, histograms and cumulative frequency tables. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Use tally marks to make a frequency table.
  • For grouped data, each class has a class interval and a class mark (the middle).
  • In a pie chart, each item’s angle = frequency ÷ total × 360°.

Examples

Example

Classes 10–19, 20–29

(10 + 19) ÷ 2

Answer: Class mark 14.5

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Leaving gaps in a histogramThe bars touch.
Adding the class marksMultiply each by its frequency first.
Pie angles not totalling 360°Check the total.
